hint: Statistics accumulate while the app is running (including lightweight mode) and persist on disk. Data is kept until you clear it. Proxy vs direct is inferred from each connection's outbound.
empty: No domain traffic yet. Browse for a while and check back.

actions.cleanupDesc: Choose how to remove persisted domain traffic statistics. This cannot be undone.
actions.clearAllHint: Delete every saved day bucket and start collecting from scratch.
actions.clearConfirm: Clear all domain traffic statistics? This cannot be undone.
actions.clearDone: All domain traffic statistics have been cleared.
actions.clearBeforeHint: Keep recent data and remove day buckets strictly before the selected date.
actions.clearBeforeConfirm: Delete all statistics strictly before {{date}}? This cannot be undone.
actions.clearBeforeEmpty: No day buckets were removed for that cutoff.
